Clockwork_Brass_Geared_Chassis.description: The clockwork brass geared chassis, a marvel of arcane engineering, hums with a relentless mechanical vitality, its intricate gears and springs granting it an unparalleled agility and speed, enabling it to move with tireless efficiency and react with unparalleled quickness in the heat of battle.

Runic_Stone_Golem_Core.description: The Runic Stone Golem Core is a ponderous, ancient construct forged from the hardened essence of primeval earth, its massive stone form imbued with runes that grant it unparalleled strength and resilience, though its ponderous nature slows its already deliberate movements.

Steam_Powered_Ironclad_Frame.description: Forged from the relentless pulse of ancient steam engines and encased in enchanted iron, the Steam_Powered_Ironclad_Frame is a towering construct of industrial might, its robust chassis granting its bearer unparalleled strength and endurance in the face of battle.

Animated_Crystal_Lattice_Body.description: The Animated Crystal Lattice Body is a mesmerizing construct, its intricate crystalline structure shimmering with arcane energy as it hovers and walks with an eerie grace, granting its wielder wisdom and charisma while bestowing the abilities to emit blinding light and reflect harmful spells.

Necromantic_Flesh_Golem_Core.description: This Necromantic Flesh Golem Core is a twisted amalgamation of decayed humanoid flesh and dark magic, moving with a shambling gait that sends chills down the spine of any observer. Its resilience is bolstered by a necromantic vitality that grants it a measure of toughness, yet its unnatural presence and the stench of rotting flesh around it repel even the most hardened adventurers.

Forged_Mithril_Lightweight_Skeleton.description: Forged from the rare and resilient metal of mithril, this lightweight skeletal structure grants unparalleled agility and dexterity, allowing its construct to move with the grace of a bird and the speed of a gust of wind, effortlessly navigating the battlefield with enhanced aerobatic prowess.

Floating_Obelisk_Hover_Chassis.description: The Floating Obelisk Hover Chassis is a towering, ancient construct of polished stone, imbued with arcane energies that allow it to defy gravity, its silent glide through the air a testament to its enigmatic origins and the wisdom it encapsulates.

Living_Wood_Treant_Core.description: The Living Wood Treant Core is a towering amalgamation of ancient, enchanted wood, its gnarled form pulsating with an inner vitality that defies its construct nature, granting it resilience and strength while bestowing upon it the miraculous ability to regenerate from even the most grievous wounds.

Jury_Rigged_Scrap_Metal_Frame.description: A jury-rigged construct of scrap metal, cobbled together with crude yet sturdy joints, this makeshift chassis grants its user immense physical strength at the cost of a diminished charisma, embodying the raw, unyielding spirit of survival and resourcefulness.

Gargoyle_Obsidian_Construct_Chassis.description: Carved from ancient, unyielding obsidian, the Gargoyle Obsidian Construct Chassis stands as a formidable amalgamation of dark magic and stony resilience, its surface cold and unfeeling yet imbued with an eerie sentience that strikes fear into the hearts of those who dare to challenge it.
